_template_note: Drop into ~/.claude/settings.local.json (merging with existing keys). Replace `<tool>` with the canonical binary name from phase0_cli.json::existing_doctor_binary (or .binaries[0] in `add` mode). Replace `<tool>-doctor-precommit` with a unique hook id if you have multiple doctored projects. The matchers here cover the common AI-driven commit paths; tune them per the target's git workflow.

PreToolUse.description: Run `<tool> doctor --quick` before any commit-like Bash command. Aborts the tool call if the doctor reports findings.
PreToolUse.command: <tool> doctor --quick --json > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'doctor blocked the commit; run `<tool> doctor` to investigate or `<tool> doctor --fix` to repair' >&2; exit 1; }
